# Day Canvas

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian infinite Canvas with a visual interface for notes, cards, images, groups, and/or arrow connections.

## Scope note

Visualize a set of related notes, images, and groups with arrows for labeled relationships.
